Trace, implement and test: leetcode561 array partition i hash simulation with stl array

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<array>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int arrayPairSum(vector<int>& nums) {
        const int maxVal = 10000;
        array<int, 2*maxVal + 1> countDict{};

        for (int num : nums)
            ++countDict[num + maxVal];

        int ans = 0;
        int n = -maxVal;
        bool first = true;

        while (n <= maxVal)
        {
            if (countDict[n + maxVal] == 0)
            {
                ++n;
                continue;
            }
            if (first)
            {
                ans += n;
                first = false;
            }
            else first = true;
            --countDict[n + maxVal];
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {6, 2, 6, 5, 1, 2};
    int res = sol.arrayPairSum(nums);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
